question: To which of the following gharanas of music did Ustad Amir Khan, a renowned vocalist, belong?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Indore__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Amir Khan** belongs to the** Indore Gharana** of music.
 
• He is one of the most influential Indian** vocalists** in the **Hindustani classical tradition** and is also known as **"Sur Rang"**.
 
• Ustad Amir Khan in fact is the** founder of the Indore Gharana,** a unique style of singing that **combined elements** of the **Kirana and Bhendibazaar Gharana**.
 
• His style is characterized by the amalgamation of multiple influences such as **Abdul Waheed Khan (vilambit tempo), Rajab Ali Khan (taans), **and **Aman Ali Khan (merukhand)**, resulting in an engaging blend of the spiritual flavor and grandeur of dhrupad with the ornate vividness of khayal.
 
• His impactful musical vision has resonated with and influenced a generation of musicians.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Agra Gharana:**

 
 
• The Agra gharana's style is known for its **deep meditative and spiritual approach** and for its systematic method of developing a raga.
 
• It includes **Nom-Tom alaaps** and **bold and forceful character of rendition** which are influences from the **Dhrupad style**.
 
• The Agra Gharana is unique in the treatment of rhythm where they use a variety of complex patterned layakari.
 
 
 
• **Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana:**
 
 
• The Jaipur-Atrauli gharana evolved from **Dagar-bani of Dhrupad **and also absorbed finer essence of **Gauhar-bani and Khandar-bani**.
 
• It has a **systematic method of voice production**, which originates from the **Veena style of playing**.
 
 
 
• **Rangeela Gharana:**
 
 
• Rangeela Gharana is a** traditional school of music and dance** in India.
 
• The Gharana is known for its **emphasis on improvisation and creativity in music and dance**.
 
• Rangeela Gharana performances are characterized by their** lively and colorful costumes** and** expressive movements**.
 
• It has a strong emphasis on** rhythm** and** percussion instruments** in its music and dance compositions.
 
 
 
• **Indore Gharana:**
 
 
• **​**The founder of the Indore Gharana is **Ustad Amir Khan **who is known for his unique style revolving around a** slow tempo **and **meditative approach**.
 
• The gharana is characterized by **long expanses of sound **that are spread over **three octaves** and are sung in a deep meditative style.
 
• The gharana has a unique style o**f taans **which includes a** fast tempo done in a slow movement**.
 
• Ustad Amir Khan’s Indore gharana combines the** spiritual flavor of dhrupad **with the **ornate vividness of the khayal**.
